name: Minecraft: Always Auth
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: AlwaysAuth's standalone session server: your Minecraft servers' AlwaysAuth plugins sign players in through it, so they still get in while Mojang's sign-in is down, with online mode left on. Any release, checked against GitHub's checksum.
startup: read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This server needs Java %s or newer, and it runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=4M -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxInlineLevel=15 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{JARFILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Always Auth. Downloads the chosen AlwaysAuth release from
# GitHub, checked against GitHub's checksum. Settings and its database are
# never touched.
repo=GamerDuck123/AlwaysAuth
name=AlwaysAuth
asset='^AlwaysAuth-standalone-.*\.jar$'
jar="${JARFILE:-AlwaysAuth.jar}"
want_version="${VERSION:-latest}"
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
sum() { "${1}sum" "$2" | cut -d' ' -f1; }
trap 'rm -f "$jar.new"; echo "The install stopped at line $LINENO of its script. Reinstall to try again."' ERR

# install_jar <url> <md5|sha1|sha256|sha512|none> <hash> <what>: skipped
# when the jar already matches; replaced only once the new one checks out.
install_jar() {
    if [ "$2" != none ] && [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(sum "$2" "$jar")" = "$3" ]; then
        echo "$4 is already installed."
        return
    fi
    echo "Downloading $4"
    curl -fsSLg --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$1" || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ "$2" != none ] && [ "$(sum "$2" "$jar.new")" != "$3" ]; then
        rm -f "$jar.new"
        fail "The download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    unzip -tq "$jar.new" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download isn't a valid jar. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
}

# The Java the jar needs, from its main class: the startup command checks it.
jar_java() {
    local main major
    main=$(unzip -p "$jar" META-INF/MANIFEST.MF 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^Main-Class: *//p' | head -n1) || true
    major=$(unzip -p "$jar" "${main//.//}.class" 2>/dev/null | od -An -j6 -N2 -tu1 | awk 'NF == 2 { print $1 * 256 + $2 - 44 }') || true
    echo "${major:-8}"
}

# release <owner/repo> <version or latest> <asset name pattern>: sets tag,
# url and sha (GitHub's SHA-256 of the file, when it has one), through the
# installer's gh-release (GitHub's API has a low anonymous limit).
# gh_tag <owner/repo> <tag or latest>: 1 when there's no such release, 2 when
# GitHub can't be reached.
gh_tag() {
    local out
    out=$(gh-release tag "$1" "$2" 2>&1) && { echo "$out"; return 0; }
    case "$out" in *"has no release"* | *"no releases"*) return 1 ;; *) return 2 ;; esac
}
release() {
    local rc=0 assets line file
    if [ -z "$2" ] || [ "$2" = latest ]; then
        tag=$(gh_tag "$1" latest) || rc=$?
        [ "$rc" != 1 ] || fail "$1 has no releases on GitHub right now."
    else
        tag=$(gh_tag "$1" "$2") || rc=$?
        if [ "$rc" = 1 ]; then rc=0; tag=$(gh_tag "$1" "v${2#v}") || rc=$?; fi
        [ "$rc" != 1 ] || fail "There's no version $2. Set Version to latest, or to a release, such as $(gh_tag "$1" latest || echo "the newest one")."
    fi
    [ "$rc" = 0 ] || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    assets=$(gh-release assets "$1" "$tag") || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    line=$(re="$3" awk '$1 ~ ENVIRON["re"] { print; exit }' <<<"$assets")
    [ -n "$line" ] || fail "Release $tag has no server jar to download. Choose another version."
    file=${line%% *}
    sha=${line##* }
    [ "$sha" != - ] || sha=""
    url="https://github.com/$1/releases/download/$tag/$file"
}

if [ -n "${custom_url:-}" ]; then
    install_jar "$custom_url" none "" "the server jar from the download link"
    label="the jar from the download link"
else
    release "$repo" "${want_version:-latest}" "$asset"
    algo=sha256
    [ -n "$sha" ] || algo=none
    if [ "$algo" = none ] && [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-build 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
        echo "$name $tag is already installed."
    else
        install_jar "$url" "$algo" "$sha" "$name $tag"
        echo "$tag" > .raptor-build
    fi
    label="$name $tag"
fi
java=$(jar_java)
echo "$java" > .raptor-java
echo "To use it, install the AlwaysAuth plugin on your Minecraft servers and set its ip-address and port to this server's."
echo "Installed $label. It needs Java $java or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The AlwaysAuth release, such as 0.5.1, or latest for the newest one. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.
